current.text: Bennett Stirtz is a first-round rookie point guard for OKC.
He is not in the OKC rotation. The guard minutes go to SGA, Ajay Mitchell, Cason Wallace and Topic.
OKC is expected to give more minutes to Ajay Mitchell and Jared McCain. That adds to the guard competition ahead of him.
His Summer League play was fine but not great.
Josh did not like the draft pick and still does not after Summer League. He dropped Stirtz from tier five to tier six in his dynasty rookie rankings.

durable.text: He projects as a very good three-point shooter off the ball.
He was not asked to shoot much in college.

note: Stirtz is not a draft target in our 12-team, 144-player auction. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 663, and his projection of 5.4 points in a small role helps no category. Leave him on waivers and only look again if injuries in the OKC backcourt (SGA, Mitchell, Wallace, Topic, McCain) give him real minutes.
